article_title: Recent rainfall predicts broader frog acoustic participation without stronger residual co-calling associations
supported_claims: In NAAMP, more recent rainfall is associated with a greater probability of multispecies calling across all standardized 5-min stops, and this rain association remains negative after temperature and nonlinear day-of-year adjustment.
In FrogID, among recordings already containing at least one calling species, more recent rainfall is associated with a greater probability of multiple calling species.

The activity-conditioned rainfall component differs across systems: the closest NAAMP conditional effect is null (OR 0.988, 95% CI 0.959–1.017), whereas FrogID shows a strong conditional association (OR 0.853, 95% CI 0.827–0.879).
Within each system's own estimand, within-space diagnostics retain the rain direction, so static spatial differences alone are insufficient to explain either association.
Within NAAMP, more recent rain is associated with a greater probability that standardized route-stops are acoustically active and with a larger run-level acoustically active species pool.

Within NAAMP, rain does not detectably strengthen species multiplicity within already-active stops, observed-minus-independence residual co-calling, fixed-marginal shuffle residual co-calling, mean pairwise excess covariance, or pairwise network density.
The hierarchy-corrected seasonal-shoulder interaction remains unsupported.

interpretation.strongest: In standardized NAAMP monitoring, the rainfall-associated multispecies signal is concentrated in broader participation across route-stops and run-level pool breadth, without detectable strengthening of within-active-stop or residual co-calling association.
interpretation.frogid_role: FrogID is an activity-conditioned cross-system contrast, not a replication of the NAAMP all-stop estimand. Its positive conditional association contrasts with the null NAAMP conditional association.
interpretation.general_implication: Multispecies activity should be decomposed into participation, observation conditioning, and residual association before being interpreted as synchrony, facilitation, or temporal-niche reorganization.

precision_bounds.conditional_or: The NAAMP activity-conditioned 95% CI is 0.959–1.017 and excludes the adjusted all-stop OR 0.946; this is a descriptive precision comparison, not a formal decomposition.
precision_bounds.probability_scale: The rain-direction bound of the plug-in residual CI (-0.00112) and shuffle residual CI (-0.00110) are each about 8% of the within-route all-stop coefficient magnitude (-0.01367); model/subset differences prevent a formal equivalence claim.
